controls: Never expose local Drizzle or esbuild development servers to untrusted networks.
Keep deployable artifacts isolated from development-only migration tooling.

exceptions.reason: A legacy Firebase Admin transitive client retains uuid below 11.1.1; removing it requires an integration-tested SDK-chain migration.
controls: Do not call the transitive uuid v3, v5, or v6 APIs or provide output buffers.
Require API integration tests before changing the Firebase Admin dependency chain.
